### Calibration Compliance Assessment

**Overdue Device:**
- **CMM-02 CMM - quality room 2**: Last calibrated on 2026-01-18, next due on 2026-07-17. This device is currently overdue.

**Impact on Product:**
Using an overdue device is classified as a stop-work quality event. All acceptance decisions made by the CMM-02 since its last passed check must be assessed. This includes evaluating any affected lots under QM-04, which also covers shipped lots.

### Action List
1. **Withdraw CMM-02 immediately** from use.
2. **Record the results** in the equipment register against the asset number for CMM-02.
3. **Conduct an impact review** to assess all acceptance decisions made by CMM-02 since 2026-01-18.
4. **Handle affected lots** according to QM-04, including any shipped lots.
5. **Schedule calibration** for CMM-02 as soon as possible to restore compliance.
6. **Monitor other devices** that are due soon to prevent future overdue situations. 

### Summary
Immediate action is required to address the overdue CMM-02, including withdrawal from use and an impact review of all affected products.

citations.title: cal-01-calibration.md
citations.snippet: A device past due is withdrawn at once - using an overdue device is a stop-work   quality event.   - Results are recorded in the equipment register against the asset number.   - An out-of-tolerance result at calibration triggers an impact review: every   acceptance decision made

citations.title: cal-01-calibration.md
citations.snippet: ## Responsibility   Maintenance and tooling owns the schedule; quality engineering owns impact   reviews. The calibration board is reviewed weekly - target: zero overdue devices,   nothing within 7 days of due unbooked.

citations.title: cal-01-calibration.md
citations.snippet: # CAL-01 Calibration of Measurement and Test Equipment (Rev E)     Covers every device at Bellbrook whose reading accepts or rejects product.     ## Intervals   - DC torque tools (station-mounted): monthly verification on the joint simulator,   annual full calibration.

citations.title: qp-spc-control-plans.md
citations.snippet: ## Gauge control   Only gauges in calibration (CAL-01) may make an accept decision. Gauge R&R is   re-run after any gauge repair and at least every 24 months on SC gauges.

citations.title: cal-01-calibration.md
citations.snippet: - Furnace thermocouples and chart loggers: system accuracy test quarterly,   temperature uniformity survey annually.     ## Rules   - Every device carries a calibration label: asset number, date done, date due.

citations.title: cal-01-calibration.md
citations.snippet: - Hand click wrenches: quarterly verification; annual calibration; a dropped   wrench is re-verified before further use.   - CMMs (2 machines, quality room): annual external calibration (accredited   laboratory), monthly artefact check with the reference sphere and step gauge.

citations.title: qp-spc-control-plans.md
citations.snippet: - Capability: Cpk at least 1.67 on SC characteristics, at least 1.33 on other   controlled characteristics, computed monthly per part and machine. A capability   breach opens a quality investigation and may not be closed by widening limits.
